profileEvidence.summary: Watchful and often closely attached to its keeper, the Sarail can be reserved toward unfamiliar people yet spring into pursuit when something moves. This Bangladeshi sighthound has a local tradition of guarding homes and chasing quarry by sight. In Sarail’s Noagaon area, the Rabidas family has passed its breeding down through several generations.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A watchful Bangladeshi hound that can be aloof with strangers, close to its keeper and quick to chase movement.
